source_policy.uncertainty_rule: Keep null when an exact same-instrument final cannot be independently verified. Never blend observations from different trade dates, sessions or futures contracts.
source_policy.cross_source_rule: If same-date sources disagree, keep the highest-authority exact series and mark validation_required; never substitute a different date or instrument.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Anthropic reportedly selects Nasdaq for its potential IPO
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters, citing Business Insider, reported Anthropic selected Nasdaq for a potential listing. The report comes after Nvidia was reported to be discussing an anchor investment in the offering.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Keeps frontier-model capital formation and the AI financing cycle in focus; a very large listing would affect AI valuation benchmarks and could reinforce compute demand, but also raises scrutiny of circular financing and capital intensity.

ai_semiconductor_news.company: U.S. AI policy / NVIDIA, Microsoft and AI ecosystem
ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Trump pushes back on calls to slow AI development and emphasizes U.S. leadership
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported President Trump said AI critics were exaggerating unlikely scenarios, while allowing that some guardrails could be considered. The comments contrast with recent calls from Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI leaders to slow model-capability advances for safety.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: The regulatory risk premium remains two-sided: U.S. policy may favor rapid commercialization and infrastructure spending, but safety pressure could still create compliance costs or slow frontier-model release cadence.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: No new U.S. cash-market session or material same-day earnings release before the cutoff
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Friday's semiconductor recovery remains the last confirmed price signal; weekend geopolitical news has not yet been reflected in U.S. cash prices.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi East-West pipeline outage now threatens up to 4% of global oil supply if prolonged
breaking_news.summary: Reuters reported the attacked East-West pipeline remained offline on Sunday. Roughly 4 million barrels per day had been routed through the line toward Yanbu; storage there may cover only about five to seven days if repairs are delayed.
breaking_news.market_impact: Material upside gap-risk for crude, inflation breakevens and Treasury yields at the Monday reopen; Friday WTI at $100.05 does not price this Sunday update.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Taiwan is a net energy importer, so a renewed oil spike would pressure import costs, TWD and valuation-sensitive electronics even if AI end-demand remains strong.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi equities fall 1.3% in the first regional-market reaction after pipeline attacks
breaking_news.summary: Reuters reported Saudi Arabia's benchmark fell 1.3%, its steepest decline since early April; Saudi Aramco fell 1.6% as attacks on infrastructure and Gulf shipping deepened risk aversion.
breaking_news.market_impact: Confirms the weekend shock is already carrying a measurable regional risk premium before U.S. futures reopen.

breaking_news.headline: New attacks around Hormuz and Saudi routes deepen oil-shipping disruption
breaking_news.summary: Reuters reported further attacks on tankers and Saudi infrastructure, a Houthi advance near a strategic Red Sea route, postponement of Oman maritime talks, and record U.S. diesel around $6.20 per gallon.
breaking_news.market_impact: Raises the probability that energy inflation stays sticky into the FOMC week and that the 10-year yield challenges or exceeds 5%.

earnings_summary.last_24h: No major U.S. mega-cap earnings were released during the Sunday window. The newest market-moving information came from energy geopolitics and AI capital-markets/regulatory developments rather than earnings.

narration_points: 今天清晨仍沒有新的美股或台股現貨完成交易；所有正式行情維持2026年9月11日，且美國週日期貨在本次截點尚未重新開盤。
美股週五最後訊號偏多：S&P 500收7656.98、漲0.86%；Nasdaq漲0.96%；Dow漲0.98%；Russell 2000漲0.45%，VIX收15.84、大跌11.21%。
但利率壓力仍極高：10年債殖利率收4.974%，位於52週區間98.3%；DXY 99.03、黃金4408.90、WTI正式結算100.05美元。
半導體週五相對強：SOX漲1.81%，AMD漲2.49%，TSM ADR漲1.21%，NVIDIA則近乎持平；這是AI鏈內部輪動而不是全面風險偏好。
過去24小時最大新增風險是沙烏地East-West輸油管持續停擺。Reuters估計若久修不復，最多可能影響全球約4%的供應，Yanbu庫存可能只撐5到7天。
第一個實際市場反應已出現：沙烏地股市週日跌1.3%、Aramco跌1.6%。因此週五WTI 100.05美元不能當成對週末事件的反應。
AI方面，Anthropic被報導選擇Nasdaq作為潛在IPO交易所；同時美國AI政策出現分歧，川普主張不要因風險論述拖慢AI領先，但允許部分guardrails。
台股最新日盤仍是9月11日：TAIEX跌1.61%，近月台指期OI 88464口、外資淨空-85067口；歸屬9月14日session的夜盤收46588、反彈0.87%，夜盤OI官方仍不發布。
本週核心不是財報而是9月15到16日FOMC；9月16日上午同時有零售銷售與進出口物價，下午2點公布決議與點陣圖，市場週五已高度定價升息。
今天開盤後最重要的三個確認點：WTI是否跳空、10年債是否突破5%、台股能否延續週五夜盤反彈。這三者將決定AI基本面能否壓過能源通膨與利率估值壓力。
